description: Prepares legal meetings end to end: classifies the meeting, then produces the matching pre-read brief, agenda, talking points, authority limits, and a post-meeting action log. Covers legal team stand-ups, matter strategy sessions, client or counterparty calls, board and committee briefings, and meetings with regulators or supervisory authorities. Use when someone asks to prep for, write a brief or agenda for, or plan follow-up after any of these legal meetings. Supports legal workflows only and is not legal advice.
